2610.04691.title: RAGStress: A controlled benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation under knowledge-base degradation
2610.04691.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is typically evaluated under the implicit assumption that the underlying knowledge base (KB) is clean, leaving the behaviour of RAG systems under realistic KB degradation poorly characterised. We introduce RAGStress, a controlled evaluation benchmark for stress-testing RAG systems under systematic KB corruption. The benchmark pairs four naturalistic corruption types (factual corruption, numeric typo, relevance poisoning, and contradiction injection) with three severity levels (subtle, moderate, and obvious) over a single-KB, metadata-filtered experimental design built from 57 MMLU subjects and 182,546 documents. Across 52,500 model-question-condition evaluations, RAGStress reveals that clean retrieval can mask robustness differences, semantic-fidelity corruptions are substantially more harmful than signal-utility perturbations, no-retrieval accuracy does not predict corrupted-retrieval robustness, and mixed-KB accuracy should not be treated as worst-case robustness. We document the benchmark's intended use, supported claims, and limitations, and provide an artifact bundle including generation scripts, corruption prompts, metadata schema, and evaluation code. RAGStress is intended as a controlled stress test for RAG robustness under KB corruption, not as a general model leaderboard.
2610.04691.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通常在隱含假設底層知識庫（KB）是乾淨的情況下進行評估，這使得RAG系統在現實KB退化下的行為未得到充分描述。我們引入了RAGStress，一個控制評估基準，用於在系統性KB腐蝕下進行RAG系統的壓力測試。該基準將四種自然腐蝕類型（事實腐蝕、數字錯字、相關性中毒和矛盾注入）與三個嚴重程度（微妙的、中等的和明顯的）配對，基於57個MMLU主題和182,546個文檔構建了一個單一KB的元數據過濾實驗設計。在52,500次模型-問題-條件評估中，RAGStress顯示乾淨檢索可能掩蓋穩健性差異，語義忠實性腐蝕的危害遠大於信號效用擾動，無檢索準確性無法預測腐蝕檢索的穩健性，混合KB的準確性不應被視為最壞情況的穩健性。我們記錄了基準的預期用途、支持的主張和限制，並提供了一個包含生成腳本、腐蝕提示、元數據架構和評估代碼的工件包。RAGStress旨在作為一個控制的壓力測試，用於評估RAG在KB腐蝕下的穩健性，而不是作為一般模型排行榜。
